description: Multi-stablecoin settlement routing. Given amount, source currency (from), and destination currency (to), returns all three stablecoin options (USDC, EURC, USDT) ranked by settlement efficiency. EURC is recommended for EUR destinations — eliminates cross-currency conversion. Returns settleBody ready to POST to /settle for the top-ranked option.

from.description: Source currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, BRL, etc.)

to.description: Destination currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.)

name: route
